  • Classes in com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.exception used by com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller
    Class
    Description
    ApiKeyCreationException
    Thrown when API key creation is denied — either the user's subscription tier does not permit API key creation, or the maximum key count has been reached.
    ApiKeyNotFoundException
    Thrown when an API key lookup by ID finds no matching record.
    DuplicateSubscriberException
    Thrown when attempting to add a subscriber whose email address is already registered in the system.
    DuplicateUserException
    Thrown when attempting to register a user whose email address is already registered as either an app user or a newsletter subscriber.
    EvaluationNotFoundException
    Thrown when an evaluation or comparison lookup fails because no record exists for the given identifier.
    NoArticlesFoundException
    Thrown when a newsletter generation request references a valid runId but the associated ingestion run produced no processable articles.
    PromptVariantNotFoundException
    Thrown when a prompt variant lookup fails because no variant exists for the given identifier.
    RunNotFoundException
    Thrown when a newsletter generation request references a runId for which no ingestion run exists in the current store.
    SubscriberNotFoundException
    Thrown when a subscriber operation references an email address for which no active subscription exists.
